note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official list, as Exophase and PSNProfiles publish it. PSN counts (0/250, 0/42, ...) are from PSNProfiles. Guides are our own words, written from the official descriptions only — no walkthrough was copied, and nothing here was checked in the game yet.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all yours, and there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the crime grinds — and watch this tracker climb to 54/55. If one trophy is holding you back, the Next up planner points at the next one in roadmap order.
